item.title: New ITR Rules & Forms: When will they be released and how will your ITR change?
item.description: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has indicated that new Income Tax rules and ITR forms will be released on time under the upcoming tax law. The revised forms aim to simplify tax filing, improve transparency, and enhance digital compliance.

item.title: Gold and Silver prices fall in early trading on MCX; Check rates here
item.description: MCX silver and gold prices opened lower on 5 February 2026 amid market volatility. March silver futures dropped 4% to ₹2,58,096 per kilogram, down ₹10,754 from the previous close.

item.title: US-Iran nuclear talks back on track; Meeting to be held in Oman
item.description: The United States and Iran are set to resume nuclear talks on Friday in Muscat, Oman, after negotiations nearly collapsed. Iran insists discussions will focus solely on its nuclear program, while the US seeks to address broader security issues including missiles and regional influence.

item.title: Parliament Budget Session: PM Modi unlikely to address Lok Sabha, May speak in Rajya Sabha today
item.description: The government is planning to secure the passage of the Motion of Thanks in both Houses on the same day, even if normal proceedings in the Lok Sabha do not resume.

item.title: Why was Air India flight cleared after fuel-switch issue? UK CAA asks questions
item.description: The UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) has asked Air India to explain why a Boeing 787 Dreamliner with a potential fuel-control switch issue was allowed to fly from London to Bengaluru. The aircraft, carrying 200 passengers, was grounded upon arrival for safety checks.

item.title: Strange Wheel Of Justice: 100-year-old man acquitted in murder case after 42 years
item.description: The Allahabad High Court bench of Justice Chandra Dhari Singh and Justice Sanjiv Kumar observed that when a person stands before the court at the twilight of their life, insisting on punishment decades later reduces justice to a mere formality.

item.description: Three minor sisters in Ghaziabad tragically ended their lives, revealing in a suicide note their deep love for Korean culture and the emotional pressure from their family. item.title: UPSC bars serving IAS, IFS, IPS officers for second chance from CSE 2026
item.description: Under the Rule 12 of Civil Service Rules 2026, candidates who are appointed to the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) or Indian Foreign Service (IFS) through an earlier exam and continue to be members of the service will be not eligible to appear in the UPSC CSE 2026.

item.title: Fierce encounter in Chhattisgarh’s Bijapur; Naxalite killed, AK-47 recovered
item.description: A fierce encounter broke out in Bijapur, Chhattisgarh, as joint security forces conducted an anti-Naxal operation. One Naxalite was killed, and an AK-47 recovered. Top Maoist leader Ramdher Majjhi recently surrendered, marking progress toward Naxal-free status in multiple states.
